newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese rail services disrupted by strike.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese rail services disrupted by strike.

text.p: Portuguese railway services were severely disrupted Friday by a one-day strike by workers protesting a restructuring of the state railroad, a spokeswoman said.
She said inter-city services had ground to a halt and many suburban services had been cancelled due to the strike by maintenance and station workers against CP-Caminhos de Ferro Portugueses.
The spokeswoman said there were no suburban services around the northern city of Oporto, but some suburban lines near Lisbon were operating normally.
Several unions called the strike to protest plans to restructure money-losing CP.
